calibration_sources: Anyscale / Ray Data StreamingExecutor & Op-Level Backpressure Policies (ConcurrencyCapBackpressurePolicy)
Apache Arrow / Plasma Zero-Copy Shared Memory Object Store & Multimodal Video/Image ETL Benchmarks
Large-Scale Multimodal Pre-Training Data Ingestion Roofline Studies (CPU Decode vCPUs per H100 GPU)

workload.dataset_profile: 500 TB Compressed Multimodal Video/Image-Text Dataset (Decompresses to 2,500 TB raw RGB frames & tokenized tensors)
workload.cluster_resources: 32xH100 GPUs (4 GPU Nodes, $80/hr total) paired with elastic remote CPU preprocessing workers
workload.cpu_to_gpu_ratio_mismatch: 1 H100 GPU consumes ~450 images/s, requiring ~24 vCPUs of JPEG/H.264 decoding; an 8xH100 node needs 192 vCPUs for ETL alone, exceeding its 96–128 local CPU cores!

tiers.name: Tier 1: 传统分阶段 Spark 离线预处理落盘 S3 + GPU 读取 (2,500TB 中间落盘放大 · 耗时 54.0h ✕)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Two-Stage Offline Spark ETL -> S3 Materialization -> GPU Read (2,500 TB Intermediate S3 Write)
tiers.recommended_for: Small static tabular datasets reused >50 times; prohibitive 5x storage explosion (500TB -> 2.5PB) for multimodal video/image tensors.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 单机同域 PyTorch DataLoader (`num_workers=16`) (本机 CPU 解码算力不足饿死 GPU · 利用率 52.4% ✕)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Node-Local PyTorch DataLoader (`num_workers=16`) (Local CPU Bottleneck Starves GPUs to 52.4% Util)
tiers.recommended_for: Pure text LLM training where tokenization is lightweight; fails on multimodal VLM/Video where 8 GPUs overwhelm 128 host CPU cores and /dev/shm.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 远程 CPU 池解耦预处理但无细粒度背压 (CPU 生产过快撑爆 Plasma 内存并触发磁盘 Spill)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Disaggregated Remote CPU Pool Without Fine-Grained Backpressure (Plasma Object Store Spill)
tiers.recommended_for: Early streaming prototypes before tuning `max_concurrent_tasks` and per-operator output queue budgets.

tiers.name: Tier 4: Ray Data 异构流式执行器 (`StreamingExecutor`) + 信用背压限流 + 弹性 Spot CPU 池 (96.8% GPU 满载 🏆)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Ray Data Heterogeneous StreamingExecutor + Credit Backpressure + Elastic Spot CPU Pool (96.8% GPU Util)
tiers.recommended_for: Production 100TB–10PB multimodal VLM/Video training & batch inference: 0 TB intermediate disk, 96.8% GPU util, and -64.8% total cost.
